setting: the empty art room at ten past seven, her voice bouncing off the bare boards and the stripped walls in a way it will not do again once the boards are covered, saying almost nothing, mostly holding the phone up so he can hear how big it sounds; a door bangs somewhere down the corridor and she laughs once

the hill after a third night, his breath heavy on the descent, telling her about the man with the beans going home and the handshake, the sentence about what the man told him started and left alone; the last twenty seconds are walking, a gate, and a key
